summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the user experience and performance of the traffic dashboard. It was decided that the 'collapse panel' feature, which helps reduce server load by disabling real-time data requests when collapsed, must be restored to both the Traffic and Mall analytics dashboards.

Additionally, it was agreed that the state (collapsed or expanded) of this panel should be saved in cookies for both dashboards, preventing unnecessary data updates when the panel is closed.
decisions: Restore the 'collapse panel' feature on the Traffic dashboard.
Apply the 'collapse panel' feature to the Mall analytics dashboard.
Save and persist the panel state (collapsed/expanded) using cookies for both dashboards.
action_items: Implement the restored collapse panel functionality and cookie-based state saving first, after completing work on Inventory tables.
